videos.title: Usability Test Demo by Steve Krug
videos.why: A complete usability test from welcome to wrap-up, one of very few freely available; watch how little Krug says and how he keeps the participant thinking aloud instead of explaining the site to them.

videos.title: Five User Interview Mistakes to Avoid (in 5 Minutes)
videos.why: Acted examples of leading questions and over-talking set against better versions; pause after each mistake and say how you would rephrase it before the fix is shown.

podcasts.episode: Steve Portigal: The art of interviewing users
podcasts.why: The author of Interviewing Users on listening, following up and running interviews remotely; worth hearing before you talk to your first five users.

podcasts.episode: How To Get Usability Testing Right: a Chat with Steve Krug
podcasts.why: Krug on keeping usability testing small, cheap and frequent enough that a non-researcher will actually do it; pairs with his demo video.

reads.title: Why You Only Need to Test with 5 Users
reads.why: Nielsen's original 2000 argument with the curve behind it; read to the end, where the real advice is to run several small rounds of testing instead of one big study.

reads.title: When to Use Which User-Experience Research Methods
reads.why: Sorts research methods by whether they capture what people say or what they do; use it to pick one method for a real question about your own product.

reads.title: Learning about users and their needs
reads.why: How UK government teams find and write down user needs through research; a format you can copy straight into a product brief or an AI prompt.
